title: BUILDING OF A HOUSE--JOSEPH AND HYRUM RETURN FROM MISSOURI--THEY
author: Lucy Mack Smith
book: History Of Prophet Joseph By His Mother
note: 1902 revised edition (George A. Smith / Elias Smith). 54 chapters. Mother's first-hand account of the Smith family.

footnotes.text: The house referred to was not completed for some time after Joseph's return. Most of the carpenter work was done by Brigham Young.--Note by Geo. A. Smith.
